articles.title: Taiko halts its Ethereum layer-2 network after a bridge exploit, token dives
articles.snippet: An attacker forged withdrawal proofs to drain about $1.7 million, the same type of flaw behind this year's biggest bridge hacks. Fast containment kept the damage small.

articles.title: Ethereum's biggest 'sandwich' bot drained of $7.5 million in ironic exploit
articles.snippet: Blockaid said an attacker tricked Jaredfromsubway.eth into approving fake trading routes, then used those approvals to drain WETH, USDC and USDT.

articles.title: Taiko urges users to withdraw as bridge exploit drains $1.7M
articles.snippet: Taiko’s bridge and ERC20 Vault on Ethereum suffered a compromise in its chain state verification mechanism, allowing forged proofs and unauthorized withdrawals.

articles.title: Secret Network bridge exploited for $4.7M with ‘infinite mint’ bug
articles.snippet: An exploit of the Secret Network went undiscovered for a week as the hacker moved the loot into Ethereum and then to exchanges.

articles.title: Notorious ‘sandwich attack’ bot Jaredfromsubway.eth exploited for $7.5M
articles.snippet: Jaredfromsubway.eth was responsible for 70% of sandwich attacks on Ethereum between November 2024 and October 2025.
